name: AccountMoved
effect: credit[newWallet] = creditMoved, credit[oldWallet] = 0 (totalCredit unchanged); newWallet approved user, linked to accountRef both ways; oldWallet unapproved, unlinked, retired for good. No UserApprovalSet is emitted for either wallet. newWallet has not signed the terms unless it signed on its own.

name: AssetRegistered
effect: New asset row. Always followed by CreditMinted in the same transaction.

name: CollateralLocked
effect: Same transaction as LoanOpened; apply the lock from one of them only. Lets reconciliation check lockedCredit from events alone.

name: CollateralReleased
effect: lockedCredit[user] -= amount (same transaction as LoanRepaid).

name: CreditBurned
effect: credit[user] -= amount, totalCredit -= amount. Never touches locked credit. user may be a user or a merchant (D-63).

name: CreditMinted
effect: credit[user] += amount, totalCredit += amount. reason is the docHash for an asset, the admin's opaque memo otherwise.

name: DefaultAdminDelayChangeCanceled
effect: The pending delay change is gone.

name: DefaultAdminDelayChangeScheduled
effect: The 3-day transfer delay becomes newDelay at effectSchedule.

name: DefaultAdminTransferCanceled
effect: The pending top admin transfer is gone.

name: DefaultAdminTransferScheduled
effect: newAdmin may accept the top role after acceptSchedule (3 days). One the Safe signers did not start means act at once. newAdmin 0 is a scheduled renounce.

name: Deposited
effect: shares[merchant] += shares, totalShares += shares, poolUsdc += assets (the amount actually received).

name: LoanDefaulted
effect: Status Defaulted. lockedCredit[borrower] and credit[borrower] -= collateral, totalCredit -= collateral, poolCredit += collateral, totalLent -= principal. No USDC moves.

name: LoanExtended
effect: Set the due date and the rollover count (the count includes this extension).

name: LoanOpened
effect: New Active loan. lockedCredit[borrower] += collateral, totalLent += principal, poolUsdc -= principal.

name: LoanRepaid
effect: Status Repaid. totalLent -= principal, poolUsdc += principal.

name: MerchantApprovalSet
effect: Set approval. A revoked merchant can still withdraw.

name: MerchantReceipt
effect: The merchant's receipt for the Spent in the same transaction; do not apply the balance change twice.

name: PauseTimesSet
effect: Store both. No liquidation until lastUnpausedAt + 7 days; a loan due on or after lastPausedAt may still be extended until then. lastPausedAt is the start of the merged disruption: never derive it from Paused events.

name: Paused
effect: Every user and pool function stops; admin setters and adminMoveAccount still work.

name: RoleAdminChanged
effect: Not emitted after deployment in practice; log it if seen.

name: RoleGranted
effect: Role given (admin action log). An accepted top admin transfer is RoleRevoked(0x00, old) then RoleGranted(0x00, new).

name: RoleRevoked
effect: Role removed (admin action log).

name: Spent
effect: credit[user] -= amount, credit[merchant] += amount. No fee.

name: TermsHashSet
effect: Current terms version. Existing signatures are not cleared.

name: TermsSigned
effect: Signer accepted this terms version at `at`. One address may sign several versions (D-25): keep every one, never overwrite.

name: Unpaused
effect: Functions work again. Followed by PauseTimesSet.

name: UserApprovalSet
effect: Set approval. On the first approval store the wallet-account link both ways; it never changes except by AccountMoved. Revocation blocks new actions only; balances and loans are untouched.

name: Withdrawn
effect: shares[merchant] -= shares, totalShares -= shares, poolUsdc -= assets. Emitted by withdraw and withdrawAll.
